_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. backup_dir: where the restore page of open tabs is written. stop_words: extra words (your name, your employer's domain) that should never pair a tab with a task. rules: which Chrome profile a URL belongs in; first match wins. 'host' matches the URL's host or any subdomain, 'url_contains' matches anywhere in the URL. Profile names are Chrome's directory names (Default, Profile 1, ...).
